Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX 4.2. Always unencrypted, must be the first field in the message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Always unencrypted, must be the second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Always unencrypted, must be the third field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Message sequence number for today's trading session.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Set to Y on retransmitted messages (e.g. following a Resend Request).

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: ID of sending firm (inbound) / ID representing A2X (outbound), as agreed with A2X. Case-sensitive, maximum 16 characters.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time of message transmission in UTC.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID representing A2X (inbound) / ID of counterparty firm (outbound), as agreed. Case-sensitive, maximum 16 characters.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Inbound only. Set to Y to indicate that the message may contain information sent under another sequence number. A2X processes Order cancel messages flagged as possible re-sends under a new sequence number, but will not process Order entry or Order modification (cancel/replace) messages flagged as re-sent. N = Original transmission, Y = Possible resend. A2X does not use PossResend on outbound messages.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Inbound only. ID representing the trading Member, as agreed with A2X, for service bureau connections.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For retransmitted messages (PossDupFlag = Y), the time in UTC that the message was initially sent. If not available, set to the same value as SendingTime.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Outbound only. The value originally sent to A2X as the OnBehalfOfCompID if received from a service bureau.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Three-byte, simple checksum. Always the last field in the message.

Message.Name: Heartbeat
Message.Description: Sent if no other messages have been sent for the agreed heartbeat interval (HeartBtInt). When sent in response to a Test Request it echoes back the TestReqID.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Echoed back when the Heartbeat is sent in response to a Test Request.

Message.Name: TestRequest
Message.Description: Sent to test the connection and the responsiveness of the counterparty application when no messages have been received for HeartBtInt + 1 seconds. The expected response is a Heartbeat echoing the TestReqID.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier to be echoed back in the responding Heartbeat.

Message.Name: ResendRequest
Message.Description: Initiates message recovery for missed messages after a detected sequence gap. May be for a set range of messages or open ended by setting EndSeqNo = 0. A Resend Request is processed even if received with a high sequence number.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Sequence number of the first message in the range to be resent.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Sequence number of the last message in the range to be resent. Set to 0 for an open-ended request.

Message.Name: Reject
Message.Description: Session level reject used to respond to messages that break the session protocol or contain missing or incorrect fields. Used rarely; where possible A2X responds with application level rejects (OrderCancelReject or ExecutionReport with OrdStatus Rejected).

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of the rejected message.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Reason for the reject.

Message.Name: SequenceReset
Message.Description: Used in Gap Fill mode (GapFillFlag = Y) to cover consecutive administrative messages during message recovery. All retransmitted messages are sent with PossDupFlag = Y.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Y indicates a Gap Fill in lieu of resending administrative messages.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New sequence number.

Message.Name: Logout
Message.Description: Sent by either side to end the FIX session. The initiator continues to process messages until it receives a Logout in response, then may terminate the connection. Under normal circumstances A2X issues a Logout only prior to the end-of-day maintenance window.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Optional free text reason for the logout.

Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: First message A2X expects to receive after the TCP/IP connection is established. SenderCompID and TargetCompID are validated against the expected trading configuration; if validation fails the connection is terminated without any message. A2X responds with a Logon echoing the requested heartbeat interval, then handles any message recovery.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Encryption is not used; the session is always unencrypted.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval in seconds. Should be set to a value between 5 and 120 seconds, as required by the counterparty.

Message.Name: OrderSingle
Message.Description: A2X supports the FIX New Order Single message for order entry.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Optional account field to specify House or Client Account for use with clearing CCP. If not supplied, A2X will assume House. ‘H’ = House account. ‘C’ = default client account, pre-agreed with the CCP. ‘C:123456’ = specific client account, where ‘123456’ is the required client account ID. Values must be pre-loaded on the A2X systems, any client specified values can be sent with a maximum length of 16 characters.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique for each Order on this session for the trading day. Maximum length 20 characters. Note that for performance reasons A2X only validates that ClOrdID is unique, rejecting any duplicates, against currently open orders.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Required if ISIN is used to identify the security, IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). ZAC = South African Cents

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Instructions for order handling. Required for AoD orders where OrderAttribute (27010) = 4. Values supported by A2X: M = Midpoint peg (pegged to midpoint of PBBO)

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: Only acceptable value (and default if not supplied): 1 = Automated execution order, private, no Broker intervention

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Security identifier. 4 = ISIN, 5 = RIC

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of shares

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type. 2 = Limit, 5 = Market at Close. OrderAttribute (27010) is only valid where OrdType (40) = 2. It selects the book and the order’s behaviour within limit orders (Post-Only, POCR, AoD, Restricted) — the order remains a limit order. An order with OrdType (40) = 5 and OrderAttribute (27010) supplied will be rejected.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price, required for limit orders. Not supported on MaC orders.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: By default, if not supplied, orders are accepted as Principal. A = Agency, P = Principal

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: If using alternative symbology, RIC or ISIN depending on the value of IDSource (22)

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order. 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: A2X security - Uniform code. Not required if alternative symbology used.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Default, if not supplied, is Day. 0 = Day, 3 = Immediate or Cancel (IOC), 4 = Fill or Kill (FOK), 6 = Good Till Date – will expire at time in ExpireTime (126) field; date must be today’s date, 8 = Good For Auction (GFA). Only Day (59=0) orders are valid for Market at Close (MaC). Auction on Demand (AoD): previously GFA-only; now Day (59=0), GFA (59=8) and IOC (59=3) orders are all valid for the AoD. GFA orders remain only valid for the AoD. IOC orders will be treated as Accept-Or-Cancel (AoC) when OrderAttribute (27010) = 3 or 4.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time this order entry request was initiated by the trading Member

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum quantity (shares) of an order to be executed. Only valid when OrderAttribute (27010) = 3 or 4.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Display quantity for an iceberg order. The remainder of the order quantity is held in reserve and is not visible. The display quantity of all orders at a given price level will be traded first and then the hidden quantity. When the display quantity has been fully traded it is refreshed from the reserve.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Date/time in UTC of order expiry for a Good Til Date order, with TimeInForce (59) = 6. Date must be today’s date.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Required if ISIN is used to identify the security, IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). XJSE = JSE (Johannesburg), 4AXE = Cape Town Exchange

Field.Name: OrderAttribute
Field.Description: Values supported when OrdType (40) = 2: 0 = Continuous Limit Order Book Regular Order (default), 1 = Continuous Limit Order Book Post-Only Order, 2 = Continuous Limit Order Book POCR Order, 3 = Auction on Demand Limit Order, 4 = Auction on Demand Limit (Pegged/Limit) Order, 5 = Continuous Limit Order Book Restricted Order**, 6 = Continuous Limit Order Book Restricted CR Order**. ** when TIF = Day (59=0), the order will inherit PO/POCR behaviour. When TIF = IOC (59=3) / FOK (59=4) the order will inherit IOC/FOK behaviour.

Message.Name: ExecutionReport
Message.Description: A2X uses the FIX Execution Report message to accept or to reject a New Order Single, and to accept an Order Cancel Request or an Order Cancel/Replace Request. Trade reports, and any subsequent trade busts, are also sent using the Execution Report.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Account is returned for Order Acknowledgements, Trade Acknowledgements and Rejects if provided on the original New Order Single message.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Average price of quantity so far traded on this order (zero if no trade)

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: The current ClOrdID identifier of the order, or the ClOrdID of the request that is being accepted

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Cumulative quantity so far traded on this order (zero if no trade)

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: As provided on the original order. ZAC = South African Cents

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Unique id for the trading day for this Execution Report.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Returned when supplied on the original order.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Sent for a trade bust (ExecTransType = 1) to identify the earlier Execution Report for the trade

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: Identifies transaction type. 0 = New (for order related messages and trade reports), 1 = Cancel (for a trade bust)

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: As provided on the original order. 4 = ISIN, 5 = RIC

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this trade (zero if not a trade)

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of this trade (zero if not a trade)

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: A2X order reference number

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Quantity of the order

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Status of the order. 0 = New, 1 = Partially filled, 2 = Filled, 4 = Canceled, 5 = Replaced, 8 = Rejected, C = Expired

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: As provided on the original order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price, if provided on the original order

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: As provided on the original order, or as provided on a modified MaC order

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Uniform symbology code for the security.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of this event in UTC

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Display quantity applicable to an iceberg order.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Reason for this report. 0 = New, 1 = Partially filled, 2 = Filled, 4 = Cancelled, 5 = Replaced, 8 = Rejected, C = Expired, D = Restated

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Quantity still open for execution

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: Market of execution for last fill, or an indication of the market where an order was routed. A2XX = A2X Market Trade (continuous, MaC and AoD executions).

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: Only provided on trade reports, the identifier of the CCP unless a CCP-suppressed ‘self-trade’ where the value is set to ‘SELF’

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Only provided on trade reports, if present value will = 1

Field.Name: LastLiquidityInd
Field.Description: FIX 4.4 Tag for trade liquidity indicator. Only provided on trade reports. 1 = Added Liquidity, 2 = Removed Liquidity, 4 = Auction (For AoD and MaC trades)

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: Market of execution for last fill, or an indication of the market where an order was routed. A2XX = A2X Market Trade (continuous, MaC and AoD executions).

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: Only provided on trade reports, the identifier of the CCP unless a CCP-suppressed ‘self-trade’ where the value is set to ‘SELF’

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Only provided on trade reports, if present value will = 1

Field.Name: LastLiquidityInd
Field.Description: FIX 4.4 Tag for trade liquidity indicator. Only provided on trade reports. 1 = Added Liquidity, 2 = Removed Liquidity, 4 = Auction (For AoD and MaC trades)

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdId of the order that is being cancelled or replaced (for solicited cancel or replace responses only)

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: To provide error text in case of a reject message, or a cancellation reason if a resting order is force cancelled

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdId of the order that is being cancelled or replaced (for solicited cancel or replace responses only)

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: To provide error text in case of a reject message, or a cancellation reason if a resting order is force cancelled

Field.Name: SecondaryOrderID
Field.Description: The A2X market data order id for tracking purposes, sent on a restatement message after the refresh of displayed quantity for an iceberg order

Field.Name: ExecRestatementReason
Field.Description: Only provided on Restatement for iceberg or MaC orders: 4 = Broker option – indicates iceberg order has refreshed, or MaC order has fully matched, 5 = Partial reduction of order quantity (exchange initiated partial cancel) – indicates MaC order has partially matched

Message.Name: OrderCancelReplaceRequest
Message.Description: A2X supports the FIX Order Cancel/Replace message for order modification as detailed below. It may be used to modify the limit price of an order and/or to increase or decrease the order quantity. For MaC orders, the Order Capacity (47) can be modified up to the point when the trade is published. For iceberg orders, the display quantity may be modified using MaxFloor (111). If the field is not sent, the original display quantity will be reused and will be applied to the modified order. Note that A2X does not support the modification of a regular limit order into an iceberg order. A2X does not support the re-opening of a fully filled order by increasing order quantity or the sending of "Pending Replace" messages.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for the replacement order on this session for the trading day. Maximum length 20 characters.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Instructions for order handling. Required for AoD orders where OrderAttribute (27010) = 4. Values supported by A2X: M = Midpoint peg (pegged to midpoint of PBBO)

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: New total order quantity (number of shares)

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Identifier for the original or last modified version of the order

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: New limit price, required for limit orders.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Values supported by A2X: A = Agency, P = Principal

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: As provided on the original order.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: As provided on the original order.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: As sent on the original order, this field cannot be modified.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time this order modification request was initiated by the trading Member

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: New minimum quantity (shares) of an order to be executed. Only valid for AoD orders where OrderAttribute (27010) = 3 or 4.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Display quantity for an iceberg order. The remainder of the order quantity is held in reserve and is not visible. The display quantity of all orders at a given price level will be traded first and then the hidden quantity. When the display quantity has been fully traded it is refreshed from the reserve.

Field.Name: OrderAttribute
Field.Description: Optional for modifies, defaults to original order. 0 = No constraint, regular order (default if tag not supplied), 1 = Post-Only Order, 2 = POCR, 4 = Restricted Order, 5 = Restricted CR Order. Note: the value set for tag 27010 on Order Cancel/Replace Request differs from that used on New Order Single.

Message.Description: A2X supports the FIX Order Cancel Request message to fully cancel an open order or the balance on a partially traded order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID

Field.Name: Currency

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: As provided on the original order. 4 = ISIN, 5 = RIC

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Identifier for the original or last modified version of the order.

Field.Name: Symbol

Message.Name: OrderCancelReject
Message.Description: A2X rejects an Order Cancel Request or an Order Cancel/Replace Request that it cannot act upon with a FIX Order Cancel Reject message.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: The ClOrdID of the request that is being rejected

Field.Name: OrderID

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Status of the order that failed to be cancelled or replaced. If an unknown order, value will be set to 8 (Rejected). 0 = New, 1 = Partially filled, 2 = Filled, 4 = Canceled, 5 = Replaced, 8 = Rejected

Message.Name: TradeCaptureReport
Message.Description: A2X uses the Trade Capture Report message from later versions of the FIX specification (specifically 4.4) as an extension to our existing FIX 4.2 ports for the purposes of allowing members to submit negotiated trades to the exchange. Trade Capture Report messages are used by members to submit a trade which conforms to either of the following standards: A Large in Scale (LIS) cross where both legs of the trade must be considered large in scale compared with normal market size if it is equal to or larger than the minimum size of order specified per security. A Negotiated Benchmark Cross trade between either an A2X member and their client or two clients of a member where both legs of the cross must be pre-agreed, priced to an appropriate VWAP or TWAP benchmark. A price-validated Cross Trade, validated against the PBBO or the APBBO. A Matched Principal Trade (MP) where both legs must have a capacity of Principal (P) set.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Required if ISIN is used to identify the security, IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). Values accepted: ZAC = South African Cents

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by A2X: 4 = ISIN, 5 = RIC. Please refer to Section 2.3 (Note on Symbology)

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of the trade

Field.Name: LastQty
Field.Description: Quantity of the trade (field name aligned to LastQty; previously referred to as LastShares)

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: If using alternative symbology, RIC (primary or A2X) or ISIN depending on the value of IDSource (22)

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Uniform symbology code for the security (not required if alternative symbology is used)

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the transaction represented by this TCR occurred (expressed in UTC)

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Date of trade referenced in this message in YYYYMMDD format. Acceptable values are for current day only.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Required if ISIN is used to identify the security, IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). XJSE = JSE (Johannesburg), 4AXE = Cape Town Exchange

Field.Name: TradeReportID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for the Trade Capture Report

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: Trade type indicating: 1 = Block Trade (default if not supplied, LIS_CROSS), 11 = Cross Trade, price validated against PBBO, 12 = Cross Trade, price validated against APBBO

Field.Name: TrdSubType
Field.Description: Further definition to tag 828 as required: 0 = Block Trade (LS), 2 = Negotiated Benchmark Cross (NBC), 4 = Matched Principal Trade (MP), 6 = Cross trade for clearing. Self-trade suppression for clearing at the session level takes precedence if the value in tag 829 is 0, 2, 4 or 6 (See Section 2.4).
